name: Toaru Mentsu no Datsui Douga
original_name: とある面子の脱衣麻雀
source:
Toma lost his wallet somewhere in Academy City. 
He heads to the 177th Branch of Judgment, but what's waiting for him!? 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE094304.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
托马在学园都市弄丢了钱包。他前往风纪委员会第177支部，可等待他的究竟是什么！？

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE094304.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
